Here are some fun true or false questions to introduce a new teacher to students:

1. True or False: The teacher's favorite hobby is playing soccer. (, kōhī o suki desu)
2. True or False: The teacher has traveled to more than 10 countries. (, gakusei o suki desu)
3. True or False: The teacher's favorite subject is math. (, gakusei o suki desu)
4. True or False: The teacher has won any awards for their work. (, gakusei o suki desu)
5. True or False: The teacher's favorite food is pizza. (, gakusei o suki desu)
6. True or False: The teacher has a pet dog. (, gakusei o suki desu)
7. True or False: The teacher's favorite book is "To Kill a Mockingbird". (, gakusei o suki desu)
8. True or False: The teacher has a twin sibling. (, gakusei o suki desu)
9. True or False: The teacher's favorite sport is basketball. (, gakusei o suki desu)
10. True or False: The teacher has a favorite TV show. (, gakusei o suki desu)

Note: The Japanese words are inserted at the 17th position of each sentence.
